title: Authority split: watch, event, transport, action
summary: ContinuationWatch describes predicate and target; ContinuationStore records edges and delivery state; EventSource publishes CONTINUATION.FIRED; HTTP server is only the loopback adapter; ooRexx/WASM controls only the isolated dummy page.
invariants: Use Intention Service READY/admission decisions before authorising real actions.
Browser Virtual Browser/API Client owns managed application/network authority; never bypass through arbitrary JavaScript fetch.
Authentication and LDAP permissions are external; loopback Origin checks are demo-only, not credentials.
Do not fabricate a ChatGPT public conversation-mutation API.

provenance.claim: Development source candidate; qualification state explicitly bounded.
